artifacts.synopsis: TE Neal Ganzel appealed his conviction and six-month suspension by Central Florida Presbytery for abuse of spiritual authority and related charges. The SJC unanimously sustained both specifications of error, finding that CFP violated BCO 32-20's one-year statute of limitations for most charges and committed numerous procedural missteps that rendered the disciplinary process significantly flawed and prejudicial, reversing the entire censure.

artifacts.synopsis: Mr. Ruff complained that Nashville Presbytery failed to comply with the SJC's prior ruling in Case 2009-28 when it concluded its BCO 31-2 investigation of TE George Grant via a case without process under BCO 38-1. The SJC found Presbytery had authority to use BCO 38-1 but erred in accepting a confession that was almost entirely abstract and did not adequately address particular sins against particular persons, and directed Presbytery to obtain an amended confession and sponsor reconciliation.
